theorems.name: Submission.imc_mlb_exists_unit_field_integral_ge
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (R : ℝ) (g : Eucl N → E), IntegrableOn g (ball (0 : Eucl N) R) μ → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : Eucl N → E, Continuous F ∧ tsupport F ⊆ ball (0 : Eucl N) R ∧ (∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (F x) (g x)) μ ∧ ∫ x in ball (0 : Eucl N) R, ‖g x‖ ∂μ ≤ ∫ x, inner ℝ (F x) (g x) ∂μ + ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
